result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major content error with raw placeholder text and a minor accessibility gap with unlabeled interactive icons.

issues.description: A section header displays the raw string placeholder 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable, localized title for the popular restaurants section.
issues.suggestion: Replace the placeholder string with the correct localized, user-facing title for this section (e.g., 'Popular near you').

issues.description: The heart-shaped favorite icons on restaurant cards lack an accessible label, leaving their purpose unclear to users relying on screen readers.
issues.suggestion: Add an aria-label (e.g., 'Favorite this restaurant') to each heart icon to communicate its function to assistive technologies.
